input.short_description: Create and list transform steps that manipulate data within pipelines via the v2 REST API.
input.body:
Transforms endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

Create and manage transform steps that manipulate data flowing through pipelines. Base URL: https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2.

Create a transform step

POST /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/transforms

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=namestringYesHuman-readable name for the transform step.typestringYesType of transformation: filter, map, aggregate, or custom.configobjectYesType-specific configuration object defining the transformation logic.orderintegerNoPosition in the transform pipeline (0-indexed). Omit to append at the end.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-transform.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_orders_123/transforms \\\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY\" \\\n -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n -d '{\n \"name\": \"filter-large-orders\",\n \"type\": \"filter\",\n \"config\": { \"condition\": \"amount > 100\" }\n }'}}

List transform steps

GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/transforms — returns all transform steps for a pipeline in order.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=list-transforms.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X GET https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_orders_123/transforms \\\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY\"}}

Transform execution order

Transform steps execute in the order specified by their order field. Events flow sequentially through each step: output from one step becomes input to the next. If a filter step rejects an event, remaining steps are skipped.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=Updating pipeline transforms|body_html=

Modifying transform steps on an active pipeline applies the changes to newly arriving events only. In-flight events continue through the previous transform configuration. Existing data in the destination is not retroactively transformed.

}} {{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=
  • Create a transform step
  • List transform steps
  • Transform execution order
    • }}

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=namestringYesHuman-readable name for the transform step.typestringYesType of transformation: filter, map, aggregate, or custom.configobjectYesType-specific configuration object defining the transformation logic.orderintegerNoPosition in the transform pipeline (0-indexed). Omit to append at the end.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-transform.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_orders_123/transforms \\\n -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \\\n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\\n -d '{\n "name": "filter-large-orders",\n "type": "filter",\n "config": { "condition": "amount > 100" }\n }'}}

List transform steps

GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/transforms — returns all transform steps for a pipeline in order.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=list-transforms.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X GET https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_orders_123/transforms \\\n -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}}

Transform execution order

Transform steps execute in the order specified by their order field. Events flow sequentially through each step: output from one step becomes input to the next. If a filter step rejects an event, remaining steps are skipped.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=Updating pipeline transforms|body_html=

Modifying transform steps on an active pipeline applies the changes to newly arriving events only. In-flight events continue through the previous transform configuration. Existing data in the destination is not retroactively transformed.
